feeds.title: Natracare Blog
feeds.description: Natracare organic & natural personal care, designed with women's health & the environment in mind. Period Protection | Mother & Baby | Beauty. Mission is to develop Natracare into a worldwide symbol for quality, innovation and ethics, available to all women as the natural choice for a healthy lifestyle and environment.

feeds.title: Eco Period Australia Blog
feeds.description: Grab the latest health tips & advice on Menstruation, relevant news stories, and more in the Eco Period Australia Blog. Eco Period Australia is a female-founded business that supplies all kinds of zero-waste and non-toxic reusable period products providing a truly sustainable alternative to the Australian markets.

feeds.title: Ruby Cup Blog
feeds.description: The Ruby Cup Blog answers all of your period and menstrual cup related questions - also the ones you didn't know you had. Learn about menstrual health and get our take on global menstrual issues, feminism, and what it's like being a social business. Our mission is to provide a sustainable menstrual health solution to all people regardless of their income.

feeds.title: AFRIpads Blog
feeds.description: AFRIpads Ltd. is a social enterprise in Uganda that manufactures and sells cloth, washable sanitary pads. Our mission is to empower women and girls through business, innovation and opportunity.

feeds.title: Bloody Good Period Blog
feeds.description: At Bloody Good Period, we work to end period poverty on the ground by supplying menstrual products to asylum seekers, refugees and those who can't afford them. Read our blog to get the latest updates.

feeds.title: EcoFemme Blog
feeds.description: Eco Femme is a global women's empowerment initiative. Rising from rural India, reaching out to women around the world, we promote and revitalise menstrual practices that are healthy, dignified, affordable and eco-positive.

feeds.title: Period Aisle
feeds.description: Periods, politics, and personalities! The Aisle team is a diverse crew of hardworking humans dedicated to building a better period. We are deeply committed to our communities, and to cultivating a more environmentally friendly and socially just way of doing business - to ensure a better future for people & the planet. On the blog, Get all the news and musings from the Aisle team. Plus, interviews with badass changemakers and taboo smashers who inspire us to keep building a better world.

feeds.title: Menstrual Matters Blog
feeds.description: Menstrual Matters is a non-profit online hub that hopes to raise awareness of the role of the menstrual cycle, and hormonal medications, in causing, or affecting, the symptoms of chronic health issues. Take control of your health by understanding how it relates to your menstrual cycle or hormonal medication. Improving the diagnosis and treatment of women's chronic health issues.

feeds.title: Dignity Period News
feeds.description: We want dignity for girls in Ethiopia - period. We are both exploring the cultural beliefs and social attitudes around menstruation in rural Ethiopia, and evaluating the effectiveness of our programs. We developed research-based interventions to improve the lives of menstruating girls and women.

feeds.title: Be Prepared. Period. Blog
feeds.description: Breaking the silence on the 'taboo' topic of periods! A site designed for girls, women & parents just like you! Here you will find a variety of information & products to help you 'Be Prepared,' including First Period Kits, Organic Options and all your other favorite 'monthly' products. Follow this blog to get your menstrual questions answered.

feeds.title: Intimina Blog » Menstruation
feeds.description: Discover answers to your period questions, menstruation advice, modern methods for more comfortable, eco-friendly periods, and why you're a superwoman who can do everything #whilebleeding. Intimina is a global brand that develops products solely for the benefit of women's intimate health.

feeds.title: Menstrual Cups Australia Online Blog
feeds.description: MCA Online helps Australian women learn about, compare, and buy their preferred TGA approved menstrual cup.

feeds.title: Menstrual Cups
feeds.description: This blog is a place to find information about the different cup brands I know about. All the brands I am aware of, are listed in the menu

feeds.title: Mythri Speaks
feeds.description: Mythri is an Animated video created to impart awareness on Menstrual Hygiene for adolescent girls. 'Mythri' is a Sanskrit name, meaning friend (female). This project was initiated in 2010 with the intention of finding effective ways to impart awareness to adolescent girls about Menstrual Hygiene.

feeds.title: Easy Blog
feeds.description: We deliver organic cotton menstrual hygiene products to your door and donate on your behalf to delivering pads and health education to girls in Kenya

feeds.title: Society for Menstrual Cycle Research Blog
feeds.description: Blog of the Society for Menstrual Cycle Research. We are researchers in the social sciences, the natural sciences and the humanities, health care providers, policy makers, health activists, artists and students from a wide range of fields with interests in the role of menstrual and ovulatory health across the life span.

feeds.title: The Period Coach Blog
feeds.description: Ending the taboo of women and the silence around menstruation.

feeds.title: Menstrual Moments
feeds.description: 'What threatens from the outside only threatens insofar as it is already within…it is not that the abject has got inside us; the abject turns us inside out, as well as outside in.' Sara Ahmed, The Cultural Politics of Emotion

feeds.title: Period Love Blog
feeds.description: Sharing menstrual magic is my passion because it has had a profound effect on my life. Your Bleeding is a Blessing. Each woman who bravely heads out to discover her own menstrual cycle and transform the negativity surrounding it will find her way to her own source of power.

feeds.title: SuperJennie
feeds.description: Super Jennie was launched on July 4th, 2015, with the mission of providing consumers the best possible menstrual solution for a reasonable price. We perfectly understand the struggles of every woman no matter what color or race every time it's their time of the month. Menstrual discomfort becomes a normal form of suffering for every woman as if being a woman means experiencing menstrual cramps.

feeds.title: Menstrualcup.co Blog
feeds.description: A menstrual cup is the healthy, ecological and economical alternative to tampons and pads for your periods. Get to know all about menstrual cups here. The healthy, ecological and economical alternative to tampons & pads.

feeds.title: Maxim Hygiene
feeds.description: Your period is natural. What about your tampons & pads? Our mission is to provide a healthy solution to the existing health and environmental risks and concerns associated with the use and production of conventional feminine hygiene brands.

feeds.title: Yoni Care Blog
feeds.description: We believe that every woman should know what she's putting between her legs. We want to break the taboo, ditch the shame and start talking about periods properly. We believe it's time to revolutionise the fem care industry. All about breaking the silence and starting a healthy conversation about periods.

feeds.title: Menstrupedia Blog
feeds.description: Menstrupedia is a resourceful guide about menstruation which helps girls and women to stay healthy and active during their menstruation. With a team of dynamic and passionate people with complementary skills, Menstrupedia aims at delivering informative and entertaining content through different media. Follow this blog to get explanation on menstruation and all issues surrounding it in the most friendly manner.

feeds.title: GladRags Gab
feeds.description: Safe. Simple. Smart. Period. Our mission is to provide high quality sustainable menstrual products and positively transform the experience of menstruation. Follow this blog to get to know more on how to save money, help the environment and make a healthy choice for your body when you switch to reusable menstrual products.

feeds.title: Period!
feeds.description: Period! is the initiative of Dutch editor/journalist Paula Kragten. She wondered why every possible topic has its own magazine, except the one and only thing that all women have in common. Nowadays, women menstruate ten times as much as they did a few centuries ago. Follow this blog to get Menstruation education and information.

feeds.title: Nicole Jardim
feeds.description: Everything You Need To Fix Your Period. I'm a Certified Women's Health & Functional Nutrition Coach, aka The Period Girl. I've picked up a few other cute nicknames like professional period fixer upper, and the period magician over the years! 🙂 My mission is to empower women in their teens, 20's and 30's to take back control of their hormonal health in a fun and sassy way. Follow my blog as I teach women how to make their hormones work for them, rather than against them.

feeds.title: Nua » Menstruation
feeds.description: Everything you've ever wondered about your period, including expert tips & tricks, to get you through that time of the month. Nua offers high-quality customizable sanitary pads that are safe on skin with no chemicals, perfume, or print on the surface.

feeds.title: Irise international Blog
feeds.description: Most of our project work is currently based in East Africa and focuses on developing a replicable and sustainable solution to the challenges girls face engaging in school during menstruation. We believe that menstrual hygiene is a girls' rights issue because of its impact on multiple human rights of women and girls including the right to sanitation, health, education, employment and dignity.

feeds.title: Moon Life Yoga
feeds.description: Welcome to Moon Life Yoga! My name is Amy, I am based in the UK and I am a nutritionist and hatha yoga teacher with a special interest in women's hormonal health. I have a Masters degree in Public Health Nutrition from Edge Hill University and 200 hours yoga teacher training with the British School of Yoga and the YMCA.Here I share all things period-related, my experience with menstrual cycle awareness, womb yoga and nutrition for balancing hormones.
